definitions.explanation: A student in their second year of a given school level. As with {一年生|いちねんせい}, the school type is given or understood from context (elementary, junior high, high school, or university).

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{二年生|にねんせい}だ。
examples.english: My daughter is in second grade now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{二年生|にねんせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: From sophomore year of university, specialized subjects increase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧{二年生|にねんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{部活動|ぶかつどう}→部活動：14539_bukatsudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you become a second-year junior-high student, you take on the role of guiding underclassmen in club activities.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧ (two years) + {生|せい} (student). The school type is normally specified (⟦{小学|しょうがく}→小学：29351_shougaku⟧{二年生|にねんせい}, ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧{二年生|にねんせい}, etc.) or clear from context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小学|しょうがく}→小学：29351_shougaku⟧{二年生|にねんせい}: second-grader (elementary)
- ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧{二年生|にねんせい}: second-year junior high student
- ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧{二年生|にねんせい}: second-year high school student
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{二年生|にねんせい}: university sophomore

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧: first-year student
- ⟦{三年生|さんねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧: third-year student
- {中|ちゅう}{二|に}: 'middle-school second-year' (very common abbreviation; also slang for awkward teenage behavior)
